core_conclusion_zh: 内置固定系统邮件不能作为管理员自由文本例外排除。9类 seed 信件与管理员收回通知均缺少西语模板来源；RemoteCopy.field 在西语下优先回退 titleEn/bodyEn。Game Admin 是服务端固定角色名，不是管理员输入。3处服务端旅人回退与真实玩家名混入同一字段，缺少可安全本地化的来源标记。

order: Read record[name] and strip boundary whitespace.
Return explicit record.translations[current_locale][name] when present and nonempty.
For sender, map only exact 系统/System aliases to localized system_mail.
For every non-zh-CN locale, return nonempty nameEn/name_en.
Only after English fallback is absent, map exact generic system title aliases.
consequences_zh: es 与 en 都满足 language != zh-CN，因此 titleEn/bodyEn 存在时西语会显示英文。
translations.es 在客户端理论上有效，但当前 MailItemResponse / game.proto / MailRepository 只传 Title/Body/Sender/TitleEn/BodyEn，没有 translations 或系统模板标记；仅向任意后台 JSON 添加 translations 不足以打通正式 Protobuf 邮件路径。
sender aliases 不包含 Game Admin；该发件人保持英文。
旧系统标题 系统通知 若带 titleEn=System Mail，会先返回英文，绕过后面的系统标题本地化。
System 发件人目前映射到 system_mail，西语是 Correo del sistema；未来宜用已有 system_sender（Sistema）表达发件角色。
field() 会 strip_edges；新结构化 reason 若要求逐字保留，不应经此裁剪或通用词条替换。

classification.examples: 9 SeedTestMailAsync title/body pairs; item reclamation title and sentence shell
classification.action: Assign stable template keys and localize from tables. Do not classify as authored/free text.
Use dedicated sender keys. Preserve custom sender values on non-system records.
Translate only with explicit fallback provenance; preserve real names including a player literally named 旅人.
Preserve the received name; no dictionary or substring translation.

classification.examples: 青岚客, 烬里人, 渡川, 石门卫, 晚潮, 折梅, 无名刃, 拾薪, 北渚, 赤苇, 听雪, 沉锋
classification.action: Treat as proper names, not missing system UI translations. Do not infer or expose isBot from name handling.
Use explicit translations if supplied; otherwise retain authored text/fallback policy. Do not translate arbitrary words within it.
Keep the original reason as an opaque raw value; localize only the system prefix/shell.

classification.examples: Kind=Gold/PriestSoul/Equipment; event names; asset ledger reason codes
classification.action: Do not translate protocol values or persistence codes. Map known item kinds to existing localized item display names only at presentation.

Separate from authored reasons. They are fixed system copy or diagnostic details; use stable display codes/templates rather than substring translation. Full error inventory was not completed in this focused audit.

recommended_minimal_stable_plan.status: Proposal only; implement after frozen UI source is released
recommended_minimal_stable_plan.principle_zh: 用稳定模板键区分服务端生成内容和管理员原文；旧协议字段保留兼容，新客户端只对有明确系统来源的内容走本地化表。

table.source_of_truth_zh: 小型共享系统文案源表，生成当前三种 locale 条目与服务端旧字段的中英文兼容载荷。避免继续硬写复制文本，也不为每种语言新增 title_es/body_es 数据库列。既有 title/body/titleEn/bodyEn 值在兼容阶段保持原字节与语义。

mail_metadata.suggested_contract: Append optional MailSystemContent SystemContent to MailItemResponse

proposed_payload.template_key: Stable allowlisted template ID with version
proposed_payload.item_kind: Existing identifier, not translated on wire

mail_metadata.compatibility_zh: MailItemResponse 当前字段1–11不改名、不换号、不复用，旧客户端忽略新字段；旧字段继续填充。同步 DTO、game.proto、生成的客户端 http_schema 与 JSON compatibility path；不要把 JSON 字符串塞进 Protobuf，也不要仅在某个 JSON 响应添加 translations 后宣称正式路径已支持。
mail_metadata.persistence_zh: 新建可空系统来源/参数列或 mail_id 关联的小表；只记录系统邮件的模板元数据。管理员自由邮件保持无模板标记。不要改已应用 V028 的 checksum；使用新的向前兼容迁移。

reason_preservation.approach_zh: 先格式化只含可信 kind/amount 的系统摘要，再拼接本地化的原因标签与独立 raw reason。reason 不经过 P.localized_text、产品词替换、递归模板展开或语言检测；必要时用独立原文 Label。
forbidden_examples: Infer that every Game Admin body is a system template
Treat a real player's name 旅人 as a fallback by string equality

fallback_name_metadata.approach_zh: 保留原 owner_name/opponent_name 以兼容旧客户端，另追加显式 fallback 布尔标记。新客户端只在标记为真时使用 traveler_default_name；否则原样显示姓名。保持当前 null-coalescing 触发条件，避免顺便改变空白名规则。
fallback_name_metadata.compatibility_limit_zh: 旧载荷没有来源标记时无法区分真实名字 旅人 与服务器回退；不能声称不改协议而且两者都能无歧义本地化。

historical_records.seeds_zh: 仅按 System 来源、已知完整 title/body/附件特征及明确版本匹配回填模板元数据；不要只按标题批量覆盖。保留 mail_id、attachments、read_at、claimed_at、sent_at，不重新发信或重发附件。现有 seed 防重仍依赖中文 title，不能借迁移改变该匹配键。
historical_records.recall_zh: 历史回收信缺少结构化 kind/amount/reason 与明确模板来源。若可用审计关系可靠回溯则回填；无法可靠归因时保留原文/旧回退。仅凭 Game Admin + 道具收回通知 不足以证明不是管理员自由撰写。受限、锚定、带全量形状验证的旧格式适配只能声明为兼容性推断，不能当新协议的稳定来源。
historical_records.short_term_no_wire_option_zh: 完全不改协议时，可用单独表对9类已知 seed 完整签名做精确旧内容适配，且在英文回退前执行；不要加入全局 inline_aliases。此补丁无法无歧义完成历史回收信和旅人来源识别，不能据此宣布所有遗漏关闭。

recommended_minimal_stable_plan.error_backlog_zh: 另行把固定业务错误映射为稳定 message key/code + typed arguments，保留原 detail 供日志/兼容用途。当前 http_400/http_409 与 COMMAND_REJECTED 太粗，不能准确选择所有业务文案。该工作与管理员 raw reason 分开。
out_of_scope: Do not translate proper names or player inputs
Do not automatically translate administrator announcements/mail prose
Do not change ban wire prefix while preserving older clients
Do not run or invalidate the frozen UI matrix in this audit
Do not start another language group

validation_required_after_implementation: Real production Protobuf MailItemResponse round-trip with optional metadata and old-field compatibility.
zh-CN/en/es for all9 seed title/body/sender fields plus item recall fixed shell.
Raw reasons containing Fire  Gold, 装备, line breaks, punctuation, braces and boundary whitespace remain unchanged.
Custom mail/announcement titles equal to existing keys/words such as Gold remain raw unless explicit translations are supplied.
Real player named 旅人/System/Gold stays unchanged; only explicitly flagged missing-name fallback localizes.
Legacy mail without metadata remains readable; repeated seeding/migration/claim never duplicates rewards.
Generic 系统通知 with and without TitleEn follows the intended system-template path.
Locale changes recompute system template copy without altering stored original authored data.
Separate diagnostic error-code coverage; no full coverage claim from scanning only CJK literals.
Native UI/glyph acceptance remains owned by root; none was run here.
limitations_zh: 只做源码扫描及 RemoteCopy.field 的静态 JavaScript 逻辑复现；未查询真实数据库、未发管理操作、未运行测试或 Godot。英文错误分支清单不是全服务端穷举。
